Based on my testing, here are all the queries:

H1: /data | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~((/address/city | type | eq ::string) !| false) | * /name | sort ~(lower)

H2: / | filter ~((/status | lower | eq "paid") !| false) | * /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | round 2

H3: / | [/dependencies /devDependencies] | reduce {} ~(union) | :map / | (map | keys | * (:key / | [(key | keyword) "@" (map | at key)] | join "")) | filter ~(/startsWith "^") | sort

H4: / | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~((/assignee/login !| "unassigned")) | * count

H5: {:defaults /defaults :services /services} | :defaults /defaults | (/services | filter ~(at :enabled | if (eq false) ~(false) ~(true)) | * ({:name /name :timeout (at :timeout | if (ne null) ~(/) ~(defaults | /timeout)) :retries (at :retries | if (ne null) ~(/) ~(defaults | /retries))}) | sort ~/name)

H6: / | filter ~(at :durationMs | ne null) | groupBy ~/service | * (reduce [/durationMs] 0 ~(add) | [/] | sum | div (count) | round 1)

H7: / | filter ~((at :stock | gt 0) !| false) | sort ~/price | reverse | take 3 | * /name

H8: / | groupBy ~/dept | * ((* (at :skills | if (eq null) ~([]) ~(/))) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort)

H9: / | filter ~(/role | lower | eq "db") | every ~((/region | eq "eu-west") | if true ~((/cpu/cores | gte 8) !| false) ~(false))

H10: "Alice@Example.com, bob@test.org; carol@EXAMPLE.com, dave@mail.net; erin@Test.org, frank@example.com" | split "," | * (split ";") | flat | * (split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort

H11: (lines | filter ~(/ne "") | * (split " ") | filter ~((at 3 | parseJson | gte 500) !| false) | groupBy ~(at 2) | * count | sort | reverse | take 2 | * {:path keys | first :count /})

H12: (lines | filter ~(/ne "") | * (split ",") | :header (first) | drop 1 | filter ~(at 2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(at 1) | * (map (at 2 | parseJson) | sum | div count | round 2))

H13: (lines | filter ~((/ne "") | if true ~(/startsWith "#") ~false !| false) | filter ~(/contains "==") | * (split "==" | {:name (first | lower) :version (last)}) | reduce {} ~(union {:name: /version}))

H14: / | * ({:total ((/comments | if (eq null) ~([]) ~(/ | * (at :likes | if (eq null) ~(0) ~(/)) | sum)) :title /title}) | sort ~/total | last | /title
